body.statement: For every observed law, \(\Theta_I(P_{\mathrm{obs}})\subseteq s-\mathcal B_G\subseteq\mathcal J_{\mathrm{HK}}\). Under ass:gaussian-observed-submodel, \(\Theta_I(P_{\mathrm{obs}})=s-\mathcal B_G\), so the affine componentwise sign union is pointwise sharp throughout the stated nonsingular jointly Gaussian observed-law family, without restricting cross-setting covariances.
body.justification: This replaces a merely valid polytope by the sharp multi-setting causal effect set.
body.gap: HuntingtonKlein2026, Proposition 4 on p. 13, proves only membership in \(\mathcal J_{\mathrm{HK}}\); it does not enforce one componentwise same-sign ratio-compatible vector or prove converse attainability.
body.consumer: Every marginal bound, effect contrast, and joint heterogeneity claim computed by the released software can be re-evaluated against the exact set.
